id.description: Unique business identifier (UUID from PagineGialle internal database)

category.description: Business category as listed on PagineGialle (e.g. Ristorante, Dentista)

phone.description: Primary phone number. Available for ~70-99% of listings depending on category.

email.description: Email address. Rarely available in listing pages (use Enricher actor for full coverage).

website.description: Website URL. Rarely available in listing pages (use Enricher actor for full coverage).

address.description: Full street address including ZIP code and city, e.g. 'Via Roma, 1 - 00100 Roma (RM)'

province.description: Italian province code (e.g. RM, MI, NA). Currently empty — use address field.

postalCode.description: ZIP / Postal code. Currently empty — included in address field.

latitude.description: GPS latitude. Available via Enricher actor.

longitude.description: GPS longitude. Available via Enricher actor.

rating.description: Average customer rating (0.0–5.0). Only present for businesses with at least one review (~10–40%).

reviewCount.description: Number of customer reviews. Available via Enricher actor.

facebook.description: Facebook page URL. Available via Enricher actor.

instagram.description: Instagram profile URL. Available via Enricher actor.

profileUrl.description: Full URL to the business profile on PagineGialle.it (e.g. https://www.paginegialle.it/ristoranteroma)

searchCategory.description: The category used in the search query that returned this listing

searchCity.description: The city used in the search query that returned this listing
